research_question: What was the U.S. inflation rate each year from 2000 to 2025, and what does the 2026 CPI data show so far?

research_brief.purpose: Year-by-year CPI-U inflation reference with the latest 2026 readings and method explained.
research_brief.audience: Readers comparing current inflation with history.
research_brief.data_period: Annual averages 1973-2025 and monthly CPI-U through September 2026, FRED CPIAUCNS retrieved 2026-10-26.
research_brief.scope_limitations: National CPI-U only; 2025 average rests on 11 months; 2026 annual figure not yet available.

content_gaps: Few pages explain why 2025 rests on 11 months.
Few separate annual-average, 12-month and December-to-December rates with a worked 2025 example.
Few show the 2026 monthly path alongside the annual table.
value_add: Every annual rate recomputed from BLS data on FRED, the 2026 monthly 12-month path, the missing October 2025 note, worked method example, and purchasing-power illustrations.
